questions.question: The addition of a rational number and its reciprocal is 61/30. Calculate the number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let the rational number be x

x + (1/x) = 61/30

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + (1/x) = 61/30

⇒ 30x² - 61x + 30 = 0

⇒ 30x² - 25x - 36x + 30 = 0

⇒ 5x(6x - 5) - 6(6x - 5) = 0

⇒ (6x - 5)(5x - 6) = 0

⇒ x = 5/6, 6/5

**∴ The correct answer is 5/6, 6/5.**

questions.question:
Find the unit place digit in the expression given below.

1! + 2! + 3! + 4! + ....... + 20!
questions.solution:
**Given:**

We have to find the unit digit of 1! + 2! + 3! + 4! + ....... + 20!

**Concept used:**

5! = 1 × 2 × 3 × 4 × 5 will have 0 as its unit digit because of the presence of (2 × 5). Hence all factorials above it will have 0 as their unit digit.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1! + 2! + 3! + 4! = 1 + 2 + 6 + 24 = 33

⇒ Unit digit of (1! + 2! + 3! + 4! + ....... + 20!) = Unit digit of (1! + 2! + 3! + 4!) = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

questions.question: C and D started a business by investing Rs. 4000 and Rs. 5000 respectively. After 3 months, C withdraws Rs. 1000 while D invest Rs. 1000 more after 6 months of the starting of business. At the end of the year C’s share is Rs. 3900. What will be the total profit (in Rs.) at the end of year?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total investment value of C = (4000 × 3) + (3000 × 9) = 12000 + 27000 = Rs. 39000

Total investment value of D = (5000 × 6) + (6000 × 6) = 30000 + 36000 = Rs. 66000

Investment ratio = 39000 ∶ 66000 = 13 ∶ 22

As, profit ratio is same as investment ratio,

⇒ {13/ (13 + 22)} × total profit = Share of C in profit

⇒ (13/35) × total profit = 3900 

⇒ Total profit = Rs. 10500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 10500.**

questions.question: The average height of 40 sticks is 154 cm. Some sticks of average height 160 cm are taken out. If the new average height is 150 cm, then how many sticks are remaining?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average height of 40 sticks is 154 cm

**Calculation:**

Average of 40 sticks = (Sum of Length of 40 sticks) /40

⇒ 154 = (sum of length 40 sticks) /40

⇒ Sum of length 40 sticks = 6160

Let x sticks are taken out

Average of x sticks = (sum of length of x stick) /x

⇒ 160 = (sum of length of x sticks) /x

⇒ Sum of length of x sticks = 160x

Now, Remaining sticks = 40 - x

Average of (40 - x) sticks = {sum of length of (40 - x) stick} /(40 - x)

⇒ 150 = {sum of length of (40 - x) sticks} /(40 - x)

⇒ Sum of length of (40 - x) sticks = 150(40 - x) = 6000 - 150x

According to question,

⇒ 160x + 6000 - 150x = 6160

⇒ 10x = 160

⇒ x = 16

Remaining sticks = 40 - x = 40 - 16 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

Combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂)/(n₁ + n₂)

⇒ 154 = [160n + 150(40 - n)]/40

⇒ 6160 = 160n - 150n + 6000

⇒ 10n = 160

⇒ n = 16

Remaining sticks = 40 - n = 40 - 16 = 24

∴ The correct answer is 24.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks the price of his table 30% above the cost price. He allows his customers a discount of 12% on the marked price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:

Let the cost price be Rs. 100

So, Marked price = 100 + 30% of 100 = Rs. 130

Discount = 12% of marked price = 12% of 130 = Rs. 15.6

Thus, Selling price = 130 - 15.6 = Rs. 114.4

questions.question: A 220 metres long train takes 33 seconds to cross a 440 metres long bridge. How much time (in seconds) will the train take to cross a 350 metres long bridge?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train (L) = 220 m

**Calculation:**

Total distance = length of train + length of bridge = 220 + 440 = 660 m

Time = 33 second

So, Speed of train = Distance/time = 660/33 = 20 m/sec

Total distance to be covered = length of train + length of bridge = 220 + 350 = 570 m

Time taken to cross it = distance/speed = 570/20 = 28.5 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 28.5 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Concept used:**

When speed is constant.

D₁/T₁ = D₂/T₂

**Calculation:**

D1/T1 = D2/T2

⇒ 660/33 = 570/t

⇒ t = 570/20

⇒ t = 28.5s

**∴ The required time is 28.5s**.

questions.question: The area of a circle is 346.5 cm². Find its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of circle = 346.5 cm2

**Calculation:**

Let radius of circle be r cm

⇒ π × radius² = Area of circle

⇒ (22/7) × r² = Area of circle

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 346.5

⇒ r² = 110.25

⇒ r = 10.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10.5 cm.**

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a hemisphere of diameter 42 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter (D) = 42 cm

**Calculation:**

Radius = Diameter/2 = 42/2 = 21 cm

Now,

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) × π × (radius)³

⇒ (2/3) × (22/7) × (21)³ = 19404 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 19404 cm3.**
